description: The mutation campaign for #260's acceptance work, part 2: the reduction SCOPE, the boundary POLICY, the DERIVED surface and the compare DRIVER (owner decisions D-4, D-5, D-6, D-7, R-1, R-2). Every mutation edits a production surface — ownlang/repro.py, rust/crates/own-shadow/src/ or scripts/shadow_compare.py — never a test, and every rule that exists on both sides is attacked on both. Three layers run for every mutation (discipline 3: no fail-fast). The policy mutations are the ones this campaign exists for: a class is not a token that excuses whatever it is pinned to, so OD-1 attached to a `changed` or a `projection` observation must stay RED. M00 is the harness-honesty control.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference's reduction scope is narrowed back to two layers
mutations.rule: D-4: the reduction scope IS the layer order

mutations.description: the reference's reduction version is left at 1
mutations.rule: D-4/D-5: a changed reduction surface is a version change

mutations.description: the port's reduction version is left at 1
mutations.rule: D-4/D-5: a changed reduction surface is a version change

mutations.description: the reference's policy gains an entry for a CHANGED observation
mutations.rule: D-5: a class explains a (layer, kind) pair, never a kind it was not written for

mutations.description: the reference's policy gains an entry for a PROJECTION observation
mutations.rule: D-5: `projection` has no policy entry — a surface that is not comparable member-for-member is a reason to stop comparing, not an explanation

mutations.description: the port's policy names a CHANGED observation instead of a status one
mutations.rule: D-5: a class explains a (layer, kind) pair, never a kind it was not written for

mutations.description: the reference judges a boundary by its DETAIL prose
mutations.rule: D-5: `detail` never participates in the policy

mutations.description: the port judges a boundary by its DETAIL prose
mutations.rule: D-5: `detail` never participates in the policy

mutations.description: the reference judges every content observation — missing-layer included — a declared boundary
mutations.rule: D-5: a content observation and a missing layer are ALWAYS unexplained
mutations.pattern: if kind not in \(KIND_STATUS, KIND_PROJECTION\):\n        return ACCEPTANCE_UNEXPLAINED, None
mutations.replacement:
if kind not in (KIND_STATUS, KIND_PROJECTION):
        return ACCEPTANCE_DECLARED, None

mutations.description: the port judges every content observation — missing-layer included — a declared boundary
mutations.rule: D-5: a content observation and a missing layer are ALWAYS unexplained
mutations.pattern: if kind != KIND_STATUS && kind != KIND_PROJECTION \{\n        return \(ACCEPTANCE_UNEXPLAINED, Json::Null\);
mutations.replacement:
if kind != KIND_STATUS && kind != KIND_PROJECTION {
        return (ACCEPTANCE_DECLARED, Json::Null);

mutations.description: the reference drops the duplicate-address ordinal
mutations.rule: D-7: the `~n` suffix is part of the pairing address
mutations.pattern: return address if n == 0 else f"\{address\}~\{n\}"

mutations.description: the port drops the duplicate-address ordinal
mutations.rule: D-7: the `~n` suffix is part of the pairing address

mutations.description: the reference's derived digest names the verdict layer, not the SARIF it rendered
mutations.rule: D-6: the derived identity is of the document THIS engine rendered
mutations.pattern: "canonical": None if document is None else canonical_hash\(document\),
mutations.replacement: "canonical": None if document is None else canonical_hash(verdicts),

mutations.description: the port's derived digest names the verdict layer, not the SARIF it rendered
mutations.rule: D-6: the derived identity is of the document THIS engine rendered

mutations.description: the derived comparison compares each engine's digest against itself
mutations.rule: D-6: a renderer-only divergence is two engines' digests differing
mutations.pattern: digests = \{eid: \(sarif\.get\(\"canonical\"\) or \{\}\)\.get\(\"digest\"\)\n               for eid, sarif in identities\.items\(\)\}

mutations.description: the driver stops failing the run when an engine crashes
mutations.rule: R-2: a crash is a run-level hard failure, never a fallback

mutations.description: the driver hands the port bytes it did not hand the reference (one trailing space — the same document, a different byte sequence)
mutations.rule: R-1/B-1: one read, and BOTH engines get that same buffer — the observable form of a second read

mutations.description: the driver stops treating an input disagreement as a domain decision
mutations.rule: R-2/D-2: two engines disagreeing about whether the input is a document is the owner's decision, not a comparison result
